title: The Garden Row String
youtube_title: The Garden Row String | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Two careful pairs of hands can do what one rush cannot.
summary: At a harbor dock where baskets are passed up, a string line for a straight garden row will go wrong if one person rushes. Anil and Nils split it into two slow jobs, while Uncle Idris only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
